title: Ngā Kaihoahoa Kōhatu
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi iwi kaha, he iwi i whakawhiwhia ki te kaha me te pūkenga, e whakairo ana i ngā whare nunui ki ngā taha maunga. He nui te whai rawa o tēnei rōpū, ā, he pūkenga hanga ahurei hoki. Heoi, ahakoa ngā whakatūpato mārama i tae mai, i whiriwhiria e rātou tētahi ara e arahi atu ai ki tētahi mutunga whakamiharo, e kore e warewaretia. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei rōpū, ko tāna kōrero he akoranga hohonu mō te hunga katoa e whakaaroaro ana?
clues: I homai he kaha me he pūkenga ki a mātou, ā, i taea ai e mātou te whakairo i ngā whare whakahīhī ki roto tonu i ngā maunga.
I homai e Allah tētahi tohu mārama ki a mātou, he mea hanga ahurei i waiho kia kore e whakararuraruhia kia kai.
I whakakake tō mātou hapori, i wero i te karere atua i kawea mai e te karere i waenganui i a mātou.
I whakatakoto whakaaro mātou ki te whakakino i te tohu merekara, ahakoa ngā whakatūpato mō te whiu nui.
I whakakeke mātou ki te whakahau kia tukua te mea hanga motuhake kia inu i te puna i ngā rā e rua.
I tūtaki mātou ki te mutunga whakamataku, i patua mātou e te pahūtanga whakamataku kotahi i muri i tā mātou mahi hara.

trial.label: Tā Mātou Whakamātautau/Takahanga Nui
options: Te waipuke i horomia ai te whenua
Ko te whakangaromanga i te pahūtanga kotahi/te hamama
Te hurihanga o te maunga hei puehu
trial.answer: Ko te whakangaromanga i te pahūtanga kotahi/te hamama

location.label: He Huānga Matua i roto i tā Mātou Kōrero

outcome.label: Tō Mātou Huanga Whakamutunga
options: I whakawhiwhia ki te taonga nui me te mana nui
Te whakangaromanga rawa i te whiu a te Atua
Murua i muri i te ripeneta pono
I marara noa atu ki te whenua hei kopikopiko
outcome.answer: Te whakangaromanga rawa i te whiu a te Atua

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
